articles.summary: Piyush Goyal urged Brics nations to dismantle trade barriers and open markets. He also called for linking payment systems and trading in local currencies.

articles.title: China Southern to resume Guangzhou-Delhi flights ahead of Xi's India visit
articles.summary: The announcement came ahead of Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to India for the Brics summit. The airline said the resumption would take its total operations across eight round-trip routes in South Asia to more than 100 flights a week.

articles.title: 'India's very interested in what we do': Firouzja, youngest to beat Carlsen's record
articles.summary: Alireza Firouzja discussed his ankle injury, recovery, and strong connection with Indian chess fans during an exclusive interview. He praised Indian crowds and tandoori chicken, assessed Gukesh-Sindarov’s upcoming World Championship match as close, and reflected on the difficulty of reaching the Candidates.

articles.summary: Haiwaan, starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, opened with a modest Rs 3 crore net collection. The film's opening day performance ranks among the lower openings for both leading actors.

articles.summary: Sebastian Stan may be joining The Batman: Part II as Harvey Dent. He compared the upcoming sequel to the acclaimed film The Godfather Part II.

articles.title: Robert De Niro and Jane Rosenthal at the Tribeca Film Festival
articles.summary: In the aftermath of the 9/11 tragedy, Robert De Niro and Jane Rosenthal launched the Tribeca Film Festival with a heartfelt mission to rejuvenate the downtown area and unite the community. With minimal resources and a strong sense of purpose, they managed to spark this monumental initiative within a mere three months, symbolizing the resilience and recovery of the neighborhood..

articles.title: Kim Soo Hyun wins advertising lawsuit
articles.summary: Actor Kim Soo Hyun has emerged victorious in a high-stakes lawsuit against a watch brand, as the court dismissed the brand's demand for 577 million KRW in damages. This verdict clears the way for Soo Hyun to secure the full contract amount, countering the brand's attempt to terminate the agreement over controversies attributed to third-party accusations, as defended by his agency..
